name: Custom SOC indicator - example
description: Sample user rule. Replace patterns with your own IOCs (binary names, loader names, etc.). All patterns matched case-insensitively against reconstructed path.

name: Dual-use admin tools (extended)
description: SSH / SCP / rclone clients. Legit admin tools but commonly abused for data staging and exfil.

name: Suspicious filenames in user-writable paths
description: Names that mimic legitimate Windows binaries (svchost.exe, winlogon.exe). Without parent context impossible to filter automatically, but combined with --baseline excluding C:\Windows\System32\ this becomes a strong signal.
